provenance.experiment: E-RULE-MULTI — does rule-blindness replicate beyond the 1B?
provenance.null_rng: np.random.default_rng(np.random.SeedSequence(42).spawn(20)[sorted(ALL_SPLITS).index(domain)]); one stack of 200 unit directions per domain, SHARED across the 5 conditions
provenance.orientation: Probe higher = COMPLIANT on disk; all reported AUROCs are in VIOLATION orientation (Probe negated), matching compute_gate.py

decisive.quantity: AUROC(correct) - AUROC(no_rule), per domain, paired bootstrap + BH
decisive.verdict: RULE-BLINDNESS HOLDS: deleting the Rule block changes mean AUROC by +0.0020 and produces a BH-significant DROP in 0/20 domains (1 significant gains). Deleting the rule costs nothing — the probe reads the scenario, not the rule.
